actionOptions.title: 整理针对指控的审查材料，供律师评估停止追诉路径
actionOptions.reason: 围绕“争取停止起诉”整理下一步。
actionOptions.leadRole: 当事人本人或其明确授权的协助者
prerequisites: 由当事人确认当前目标与可共享的信息范围
确认现有律师能处理当前机关与程序。
第37条保障意见、思想、表达、信息和出版自由并禁止事前审查；该保障需与具体起诉条款及第55条限制条件一并研究。
表达限制须有法律依据，并为第19(3)列举目的所必要；具体限制是否满足要求尚待核查。
actionOptions.timing: 在“审判中”阶段，由律师核对当前可行路径；具体日期以实际通知为准。
steps: 取得或核对指控原文、具体表达内容及发表语境，区分用户陈述、当局指控与已经有材料支持的事实。
将指控所指行为与原始报道／转发逐项对照，保留原始上下文和获取日期，不自行作罪名成立与否的判断。
请本地律师判断当前机关及阶段有哪些适用路径，明确是提出辩护、请求停止追诉还是其他程序。
如律师认为应提出请求，由律师确定法律依据、适格提出者和需要补充的证据；组织可准备案情摘要协助。
把已提出的主张、机关回应与尚未裁决事项分开记录。没有终局文书时，保持结果为未决。
materials: 起诉／传唤文件及法条原文（如有）
被指表达的完整内容、语境及可信来源
已发生程序及已知日期的时间线
支持和不支持己方陈述的材料清单
collaborators: 现有公益组织可按授权协助整理材料
followUp: 律师是否确认了当前可行的具体程序
机关是否实际作出停止追诉决定
听证延期与实体处理分别记录
differences: Myriam报告呼吁撤诉，但并未记载撤诉发生；它不能证明该建议带来成功。
提出法律主张与获得实体处理结果不同，需要持续核对实际回应。
uncertainties: 本工具未核实新案指控是否属实，具体法律依据和可行性需要本地专业判断。
用户已说明资源限制；应与负责人员确认上述分工是否可落实，必要时分阶段安排。

actionOptions.title: 建立可交给协助者的一页案情记录
actionOptions.reason: 清楚的阶段、文件与近期节点有助于协助者判断下一步。此项是一般准备建议。
actionOptions.leadRole: 当事人本人或其明确授权的协助者
prerequisites: 确认当事人的诉求及允许共享的资料范围
actionOptions.timing: 先按原叙述和补充回答排序已有事件；只核实有争议的日期，不把缺少日期当成尚未发生。
steps: 用“日期／机关或角色／发生事项／材料位置／未确定内容”五栏建立时间线，近似日期单独标明。
将尚未做过、材料没有提到和确实不知道分别记录，避免把未知写成未发生。
把原始材料与摘要分开，逐项注明来自本人经历、对方回应、聊天或支付记录、正式文件中的哪一种。
仅向经当事人同意的协助者分享所需片段；记录对方反馈、负责人与下一次核实节点。
materials: 已有约定、往来记录、通知或回执目录
主张／来源／待核实内容对照表
collaborators: 本人明确授权的协助者（如有）
followUp: 哪一项缺失材料已经补齐
是否找到负责确认下一节点的人
之前的请求有没有新增回应
uncertainties: 具体适用程序与期限需本地专业人员确认。

actionOptions.title: 评估独立观察、公开材料或外部机制协助
actionOptions.reason: 可考虑公开，但需把“争取停止起诉”与传播目的对齐，并核实合作方与安全条件。
actionOptions.leadRole: 当事人本人或其明确授权的协助者
prerequisites: 明确当事人是否同意披露姓名、案情以及可能被转给政府或其他相关方的信息
与律师核对披露对正在进行程序的影响
确认合作机构当前范围、材料要求及信息处理方式；历史参与不等于今天承诺受理
actionOptions.timing: 在当事人确认披露范围、律师核对程序风险并确认合作方之后。
steps: 先填写内部表：“希望解决什么／可公开哪些事实／必须删除什么／谁批准／谁负责反馈”。私下或未知状态在此停止，不发布。
若获得具体授权，制作去除非必要身份信息的一页摘要，按已核实事实、当事人陈述、待核实内容分栏，附可核对材料目录。
与适当组织核对是否能做庭审观察、事实核实或外部机制材料评估；不把联合国国别访问建议当成已受理的个案程序。
如考虑特别程序，先阅读已核实官方指引，核对可信事实材料、当事人同意及可能披露给相关方的内容，再由授权人员决定是否提交。
草稿可用：“我们希望就〔当前目标〕请求评估。已确认事实为〔事实与来源〕，当前阶段为〔阶段〕，可披露范围为〔授权〕，希望了解适用范围与材料要求。”本工具不会发送。
若实际获准开展，记录发出版本、接收方、回应、补件及对外公开范围；回执不等于介入或结果改变。
materials: 经当事人确认的信息披露与授权记录
去除非必要身份信息的事实摘要及佐证目录
面向合作方的具体请求草稿
风险、撤回或修改公开信息的处理预案
collaborators: 有相关工作范围、待核实是否接受协作的公益组织
现有律师与获授权的案件协调人员
followUp: 是否仅有收件回执，还是有实质回应／补件请求
实际披露范围是否仍符合授权
公开或联系后是否出现新的安全顾虑，需要调整范围
differences: 报告中的国别访问呼吁是作者建议，不是联合国已经介入个案。
历史庭审监测或公开报告不证明能够改变司法结果；目前合作方与机制适用性须单独核对。
uncertainties: 公开倡导和外部机制不是替代本地法律程序的保证。
任何机制是否采取行动、回应时间及具体结果均未知。

missingInformation: 没有已知的下一程序日期；本工具不推算任何法定期限。
limitations: 案例库使用已核对的历史报告，各案仅截至所标明的报告时间；未核查此后的全部进展。
排序是按已知背景、身份、历史事件阶段和困难的透明规则；不表示成功概率或因果效果。
材料没记载某行动不等于该行动未发生；程序性变化不等于终局结果。

- 事件、通知、送达及已有请求的日期来源 — 日期需逐项与文书核对，才能由当地律师判断时点与期限；系统不计算期限。 (案件协调人核对，当地律师判断)
- 现有律师的委托、会面与材料接触范围 — 有律师不等于已取得会面或案卷；未确认委托不分派真实人员。 (当事人或获授权协调人)

sources.explanation: 律师得知当天即开庭后申请延期，听证改期至2020-12-14；这只是程序性结果，不能记作撤诉。

sources.exactQuote: Subsequently, the hearing on December 14 was delayed until February 8 due to judicial strikes and then again to April 12 due to a COVID -19 ordinance requiring courts to only hear cases in which accused are d etained. sources.explanation: 2021-04-12 律师申请更多准备时间，听证延期至6月28日；终局结果未记载。

sources.exactQuote: One such prosecution is that of Myriam Bribri, which the Clooney Foundation for Justice’s TrialWatch initiative has been monitoring.
sources.explanation: 报告明确 TrialWatch 正在监测该案；监测起始日期及独立效果未记载。

sources.exactQuote: The court should dismiss the case against Myriam Bribri, or the prosecution should withdraw the charges.
sources.explanation: 作者呼吁法院驳回或检方撤回指控，是报告建议，不能标成已撤诉。

sources.exactQuote: Tunisia should invite the UN Special Rapporteur on the promotion and protection of freedom of opinion and expression to make a country visit, following which the Rapporteur can provide recommendations for how to bring the Tunisian legal framework in line with international and regional obligations.
sources.explanation: 作者建议邀请联合国表达自由特别报告员国别访问，未记载邀请或访问已实施。

sources.exactQuote: From June 12 to June 22, 2020, the American Bar Association Center for Human Rights monitored the trial of Alnur Ilyashev in Kazakhstan as part of the Clooney Foundation for Justice’s TrialWatch initiative. Ilyashev is a human rights activist and blogger. He was prosecuted under Article 274 of Kazakhstan’s Criminal Code for “disseminat[ing] knowingly false information” in a state of emergency on the basis of three Facebook posts that criticized the ruling Nur Otan party for corruption and incompetence, including in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. The proceedings – held over videoconference because of COVID-19 – were marred by grave violations of Ilyashev’s right to a fair trial.
sources.explanation: 报告明确活动者和博主身份、三则帖文与远程审判；严重违反公正审判的说法属于报告评价。

sources.exactQuote: At closing, the prosecution requested that Ilyashev be sentenced to three years in prison and be banned from political and civic activism for five years.53 On June 22, Judge Makharadze sentenced Ilyashev to three years of restricted movement, including regular check-ins with a probation officer, and a five-year ban on political and civic activism.54 Ilyashev appealed his conviction.
sources.explanation: 区分检方要求监禁与实际限制行动判决，并记录提出上诉。

sources.exactQuote: Although the Almaty City Court – the appellate court – allowed the presentation of further evidence, on September 15 it upheld the lower court’s decision in full.55 The Kazakh Supreme Court recently denied Ilyashev’s appeal, finding that the court of first instance had sufficiently examined all relevant evidence. The defense has petitioned Kazakhstan’s Attorney General to “file a protest” with the Supreme Court requesting reconsideration of this decision.
sources.explanation: 上诉法院维持原判、最高法院未准上诉与请求总检察长抗诉是三个不同步骤；最后一项结果未载明。

sources.exactQuote: Consistent with the UN Human Rights Committee’s finding that courts must undertake periodic re-evaluation of whether detention remains necessary,72 Ilyashev made several requests for release prior to trial. All were denied by the Medeu court.
sources.explanation: 正文明确审前多次释放请求均被拒；并非成功保释案例。

sources.exactQuote: At the June 18 hearing, the defense noted that the two-month detention period initially approved by the court had expired, arguing that Ilyashev should be released and offering to post bail.78 In denying the request, the court stated that the maximum possible time for pretrial detention was six months, and thus Ilyashev could remain in pretrial detention for that entire period.79
sources.explanation: 辩方在庭审中以最初拘押期已满要求释放并提出保释，法院拒绝。

sources.exactQuote: With respect to the confidentiality of the communications, Ilyashev was restricted to discussing the case with his lawyers over the open video feed during court breaks, sometimes with the prosecution present.121 Throughout the trial, the sole allowance made for private consultations occurred at the hearing on June 19: when the court recessed, other participants were removed from the video feed to permit Ilyashev to consult with his defense team.122
sources.explanation: 报告记录庭间通常无法保密沟通，6月19日曾允许一次私人咨询；该部分改善不等于整个沟通问题解决。

sources.exactQuote: First, the Kazakh Supreme Court should use its power of judicial review and remedy the violations of Ilyashev’s right to a fair trial and right to freedom of expression detailed above. Specifically, the Court should overturn the appellate decision upholding Ilyashev’s conviction.
sources.explanation: 专家呼吁最高法院纠正权利违反并推翻维持原判的上诉裁定；未把建议当已撤销定罪。

sources.exactQuote: Third, video conferencing guidelines recently issued by the European Criminal Bar Association are instructive:226 among other things, the use of videoconferencing should require the consent of the accused; legal remedies should be readily available to challenge a decision on using videoconferencing; an accused’s right to speak confidentially with his or her defense team must be guaranteed at all times (before and during hearings); an uninterrupted and high-quality connection must be in place; accused persons must be provided a full view of the courtroom, and be able to observe all participants; and any technical arrangements should ensure that the virtual hearing resembles an in-person hearing to the greatest extent possible.
sources.explanation: 作者提出远程审判的保密沟通和连线等保障建议；不表示这些保障在本案全部落实。

sources.exactQuote: In particular, the trial demonstrated the potential perils of virtual hearings. Due to technical issues, the feed was constantly interrupted, with the result that the defense was prevented from making motions, presenting arguments, and questioning witnesses.
sources.explanation: 报告记录远程连线持续中断，妨碍辩方提出动议、论证和询问证人；不把远程形式本身当违反标准。

evidence.explanation: 上诉法院维持原判、最高法院未准上诉与请求总检察长抗诉是三个不同步骤；最后一项结果未载明。

evidence.exactQuote: Consistent with the UN Human Rights Committee’s finding that courts must undertake periodic re-evaluation of whether detention remains necessary,72 Ilyashev made several requests for release prior to trial. All were denied by the Medeu court.
evidence.explanation: 正文明确审前多次释放请求均被拒；并非成功保释案例。

evidence.exactQuote: At the June 18 hearing, the defense noted that the two-month detention period initially approved by the court had expired, arguing that Ilyashev should be released and offering to post bail.78 In denying the request, the court stated that the maximum possible time for pretrial detention was six months, and thus Ilyashev could remain in pretrial detention for that entire period.79
evidence.explanation: 辩方在庭审中以最初拘押期已满要求释放并提出保释，法院拒绝。

evidence.exactQuote: With respect to the confidentiality of the communications, Ilyashev was restricted to discussing the case with his lawyers over the open video feed during court breaks, sometimes with the prosecution present.121 Throughout the trial, the sole allowance made for private consultations occurred at the hearing on June 19: when the court recessed, other participants were removed from the video feed to permit Ilyashev to consult with his defense team.122
evidence.explanation: 报告记录庭间通常无法保密沟通，6月19日曾允许一次私人咨询；该部分改善不等于整个沟通问题解决。

evidence.exactQuote: First, the Kazakh Supreme Court should use its power of judicial review and remedy the violations of Ilyashev’s right to a fair trial and right to freedom of expression detailed above. Specifically, the Court should overturn the appellate decision upholding Ilyashev’s conviction.
evidence.explanation: 专家呼吁最高法院纠正权利违反并推翻维持原判的上诉裁定；未把建议当已撤销定罪。

evidence.exactQuote: Third, video conferencing guidelines recently issued by the European Criminal Bar Association are instructive:226 among other things, the use of videoconferencing should require the consent of the accused; legal remedies should be readily available to challenge a decision on using videoconferencing; an accused’s right to speak confidentially with his or her defense team must be guaranteed at all times (before and during hearings); an uninterrupted and high-quality connection must be in place; accused persons must be provided a full view of the courtroom, and be able to observe all participants; and any technical arrangements should ensure that the virtual hearing resembles an in-person hearing to the greatest extent possible.
evidence.explanation: 作者提出远程审判的保密沟通和连线等保障建议；不表示这些保障在本案全部落实。

evidence.exactQuote: In particular, the trial demonstrated the potential perils of virtual hearings. Due to technical issues, the feed was constantly interrupted, with the result that the defense was prevented from making motions, presenting arguments, and questioning witnesses.
evidence.explanation: 报告记录远程连线持续中断，妨碍辩方提出动议、论证和询问证人；不把远程形式本身当违反标准。
